checks.name: haversine: 1° of latitude = R·π/180 (111 195.08 m), mm rounding once
mean objective on the equator case is {c1,c2}: ties of equal cost/sum broken by sorted IDs
all subsets enumerated (2^3=8), feasible = subsets with ≤2 sites and cost ≤ 20 (7)
three objectives may coincide: no artificial difference
required sites cost more than the budget → infeasible with reason, constraints not dropped
more required sites than max_selected → infeasible (required_over_count)
zero budget: only the empty plan is feasible; all three winners are the empty plan
no candidates: one subset (the empty plan), status optimal
no baseline records of the category: before = null, after = null for the empty plan (not 0)
no baseline: after known from a site, delta stays null
no baseline: winners minimise unknown_count first (never a partial sum before it)
Pareto (cost, weighted_sum_mm): no point dominated, equal pairs collapsed, sorted by cost, plans with c4 absent
coverage objective maximises covered weight first
input order of points/candidates changes neither the plans nor problem_digest
selected_ids: same problem_digest, different scenario digest
budget (or any problem field) changes problem_digest
unfinished search is never 'optimal' and carries no winners
manual plan over count and budget is evaluated and marked infeasible with both reasons
manual plan with an excluded site and without a required one → has_excluded, missing_required
tie between a source record and a site at the same place: nearest after stays the source (no fake improvement)
Pareto: two plans with equal cost and sum collapse to one point with the smaller IDs ({c1}, not {c3})
